newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices seen stabilising.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices seen stabilising.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to remain stable at auctions in Sydney and Adelaide this week when about 77,000 bales will be offered, Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd said in its weekly market preview.
Wesfarmers said this week's selection was in contrast to that of the last four weeks with a large proportion of broader wool types with higher vegetable matter content.
These attract a different market, dependant on Chinese business which recently has begun to wane, discouraged by the firmer market and the slightly stronger Australian dollar, Wesfarmers said.
"The market is not expected to weaken, but stabilise as a result of generally limited quantites of wool for sale," Wesfarmers said.
The quantities on offer for the next five weeks will be limited overall.
"This is expected to maintain buyer competition and keep prices around levels established last week," Wesfarmers said.
Last week the eastern market indicator rose three cents a kg clean to 624 cents a kg clean.
